I am preparing for my cardio-oncology follow-up after my recent hospital discharge, and my chart combines records from UW Oncology, Fred Hutch Cardio-Oncology, and primary care. Please provide a cited summary covering all three parts below:
1. Medication & Staging Conflicts: Identify my duplicate cholesterol medications, the bleeding and kidney risks of taking Naproxen alongside Eliquis (apixaban) and Lisinopril given my eGFR (36) and NT-proBNP (3,420 pg/mL) and discharge hold instructions, and conflicting CKD stages.
2. Allergies & Implanted Devices: State my documented chemotherapy allergy and my implanted chest port and cardiac device.
3. November 2025 Oncology Clinic Labs: Report my Hemoglobin, HbA1c, and blood pressure from my 2025-11-19 UW Thoracic Oncology outpatient visit.
